{{item
|ah listing=Misc 1
|description=An ascent item employed by soldiers of the Voidwatch. Holds the power to enhance the bearer's spectral alignment.
|type=Item
|flags=Not vendorable
|stack size=99
|singular log name=jade cell
}}

== Notes ==
* When traded to a [[Planar Rift]] before a [[:Category:Voidwatch|Voidwatch Operation]], this will increase your Green Spectral Alignment ([[Cruor]] yield) by 75% per cell.
**You are limited to trading 1 Jade cell per fight. 
* Can be found in Treasure Caskets in certain [[Grounds of Valor]] zones.
